_doc: Revert-verify mutants for req fe50da38-4798-46e6-bb0a-b4b88596c340 (issue #4440), ObsidianVaultAdapter half. The expectations below were written BEFORE the run (sparql-iri-form-pre-verify §A18). Axis names are the machine key: red_re reads the name right after the last `›`, so every axis is named A<n>/B<n> as its FIRST token (integration-test-revert-verify §A47/§A104). ⛤ The NoteToRDFConverter half cannot live here — mutant-driver takes ONE subject — it is ObsidianVaultAdapter.frontmatter-parse-failure.converter.spec.json. ⛔ 'capability entirely absent' is NOT a mutant here: deleting the method makes the suite reference a non-existent member, which is a BROKEN verdict, not a red axis (§A97). M1 is its behavioural equivalent — the method exists and never reports.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/obsidian-plugin/src/adapters/ObsidianVaultAdapter.ts

M1_adapter_never_reports._note: The pre-#4440 world in behavioural form: the adapter is blind, so a malformed asset is dropped with no skip-list entry. Type-preserving (both branches still return the declared union). The CONTROL axes stay green by construction — they assert silence, which a blind adapter also produces; that asymmetry is what makes them controls rather than duplicates of A5.

M2_collapse_no_block_into_a_failure.from:
// Outcome 1 — no block at all: a plain note, legitimately not an asset.
    if (body === null) return null;
M2_collapse_no_block_into_a_failure.to:
// Outcome 1 — no block at all: a plain note, legitimately not an asset.
    if (body === null) return { reason: "no frontmatter" };
M2_collapse_no_block_into_a_failure._note: The OVER-WIDE fix the requirement's acceptance names explicitly as the risk: report any null frontmatter. A report-only acceptance would pass it, which is why A1/B2 exist. A7 stays green — an unreadable file returns before this line.

M3_drop_the_no_content_line_predicate._note: Both legitimate 'no keys yet' shapes — the blessed empty block and a comment-only body — become reported noise. `false &&` keeps the expression's form (and `hasContentLine` used), so no type-narrowing is lost.

M4_author_the_reason_instead_of_taking_t.from:
reason:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message.split("\n")[0] : String(error),
M4_author_the_reason_instead_of_taking_t._note: The reason must be DERIVED from the mechanism, not authored — an authored string cannot drift from the parser because it never agreed with it in the first place. B1 reddens because the skip-list entry stops carrying the diagnosis the user needs.

M5_claim_an_unreadable_file_is_a_parse_f._note: Narrow by construction: only the missing-file axis reaches the read's catch. Guards against putting a wrong REASON in front of the user for a file that is merely gone (a race with a delete, an unreadable mount).
